description: Canonical versioned schema for normalized drug safety and quality evidence.

evidence_id.description: Unique identifier assigned to the evidence record.

source_organisation.description: Organisation responsible for or associated with the source.

drug_product_identifier.description: Drug or product identifier associated with the evidence.

observation.description: What was actually reported or observed.

date.description: Date associated with the evidence record.

population_context.description: Population, study, laboratory, product, or other context.

measurement_result.description: Reported measurement or result, when applicable.

supporting_documentation.description: Document or material supporting the evidence.

original_source.description: Original source from which the record originated.

original_evidence_id.description: Identifier used by the original source or source dataset.

ingestion_timestamp.description: Timestamp when the evidence entered the integration pipeline.

source_version.description: Source dataset or source version when available.

transformation_path.description: Ordered list of transformations applied to the evidence.

validation_status.description: Current validation state of the evidence record.

reviewer_action.description: Recommended human review or follow-up action.

human_review_flag.description: Indicates whether human review is required.

interpretation.description: Optional interpretation kept separate from the raw observation.
